subject: science
concept: Understanding kinetic and potential energy and the conservation of energy
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Energy) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student releases a physical object from height and observes potential energy converting to kinetic energy as it falls
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a scenario to whether energy is stored (potential) or in motion (kinetic)
exercise.abstract: Student explains how energy converts between potential and kinetic forms in a described scenario, without being created or destroyed

misconception_flags: believes energy is lost entirely rather than converted or transferred to another form

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
